title: Jesus at the Center
speaker: Pastor Jeremy Govender
summary: Pastor Jeremy Govender challenges believers to recognize how living for convenience carries real consequences. He urges intentional discipline in areas like family, marriage, church, prayer, and Scripture, reminding us that God's unchanging word sets the standard and will not bend to our preferences. We cannot expect the fruit of godly principles while living contrary to them; life must be centered on Jesus rather than convenience.
